product: A one page website for a local business (a restaurant first), built from what the owner's site already says.

features.name: The site has a home page, a menu page and a story page
features.description: The home page shows the sections from the reference visibleSections() list, in its order, read from src/content/site.ts. The full menu is its own page at /menu, and the owner's story is its own page at /story. A section or page with nothing real to show is not drawn and its link is not shown.
acceptance_criteria: The home page shows only sections that have real content, in the default order: hero, menu highlights, menu teaser (category chips and one button to /menu), about or short story, gallery, reviews, catering, ways to enjoy us, footer.
/menu exists only when the menu has dishes. It shows every category and dish with the category chips. Nothing on it is added or reworded.

/story exists only when the brief has a story with real words (hasStory). When it exists the home page shows its first paragraph with a Read our story link, and the top bar shows Our story. When it does not exist there is no /story route, no link to it, and the home page shows the About text instead.
A switched-off section (brief page_plan.off) is absent from the page and from the navigation. The hero and the footer cannot be switched off.
All content is read from src/content/site.ts. There is no database, no API route and no environment variable.
The top bar and footer are the same on every page (components/Shell.tsx). The slim bar with Reserve, Order online and Call us is on the home page only.
The layout works from 360px to wide desktop with no horizontal scrolling.
verification: Render /, /menu and /story at 360px and 1280px and look at them.
Open /story on a brief with no story: it is a 404, and no link anywhere points to it.
Check that every top bar link goes to a page or section that exists.

features.name: The page uses design restaurant_001
features.description: The components, styles and display rules in reference/ are copied into the app and used as written. The agent writes the content file, the layout, the fonts and the tests.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/content.ts is the reference file unchanged. Section components are the reference components. The agent does not rewrite their markup or restyle them.
The accent colour comes from look.accent in the brief and is set as --accent on the page wrapper. Text on the accent is white or near-black, whichever passes 4.5:1, set as --accent-text.
Fonts are loaded with next/font and set as --font-heading and --font-body. A change to the look goes through the brief, not through edits to the components.
verification: Diff src/lib/content.ts and src/components/restaurant against reference/.
Check button text contrast against the accent.

features.name: Hero with the name as the heading
features.description: A fixed top bar, then a hero with the restaurant name as the h1, the kind of place, the tagline, and up to three buttons.
acceptance_criteria: The restaurant name is the page's only h1.

The reserve action is, in this order: the owner's own booking link (Reserve a table, new tab), else the request form when the brief gives reservations.endpoint (see the reserve feature), else a phone call (Call to reserve), else nothing. Order online shows when an order link exists, View menu only when there is no reserve action and no order link, and Call us only when the reserve action is a link or the request form and a phone exists.
Every button has a real https, tel or mailto address. No button has href='#' or an empty address.
With a photo allowed the hero uses it under a dark scrim; otherwise a colour field made from the accent. Text contrast is at least 4.5:1.
The only form in the hero is the table request form, and only in request mode. With the owner's own booking link, or with only a phone, there is no form.
verification: Check the hero for each case: reserve link, phone only, neither.
Confirm there is exactly one form in the hero in request mode and none in the other cases.

features.name: Reserve action and slim bar
features.description: One reserve action used in the top bar, the hero and a slim bar that slides in when the hero has scrolled away. Order: the owner's own booking link, else the table request form, else a phone call, else nothing. The slim bar carries the same action as the hero, each button only when it goes somewhere real.
acceptance_criteria: With a booking link, the button reads Reserve a table and opens the link in a new tab with rel noopener noreferrer.
With only a phone, the button reads Call to reserve and starts a call.
With neither a link, an endpoint nor a phone, no reserve button, no slim bar and no reserve card exist.
The slim bar appears after scrolling past the hero and disappears when scrolling back.

Request mode needs reservations.endpoint to be an https address and no booking link. The hero then holds the form from components/ReserveForm.tsx, used as written: day, time and guests first; then name and a phone or an email. The button reads Request a table. After sending, the guest is told the restaurant will confirm by phone or email and that it is not a booking until they do. The words Find tables, Book now, Booked and Confirmed are never used.

In request mode the slim bar carries the same form in compact form on wide screens, and a single Request a table button that scrolls to the hero form on phones. The top bar button reads Request a table and goes to /#reserve.
The form posts JSON to the endpoint and to nowhere else. A failed send shows the reason and, when a phone exists, a Call link. A hidden field named website is left empty by people.
verification: Render the three cases and count the reserve buttons.
Scroll the page in a browser and check the slim bar.
In a browser, fill the form on a wide and a narrow screen and check the request posted to the endpoint with the day, time, party, name and phone.

features.name: Full menu by category
features.description: Every category and dish from the owner, in order, with the owner's spelling, descriptions and prices. It is shown on its own page at /menu.
acceptance_criteria: All categories and all items appear, in the order given, with names exactly as given. Spelling is not corrected.
A price shows exactly as written. A dish without a price shows no price and no placeholder.
With show_prices false no price appears anywhere on the page, including the highlights.
With two or more categories, chips above the menu jump to each category and scroll sideways on a narrow screen.
A menu of 120 or more items renders without layout breaks. A category with no items is not drawn.
verification: Compare the page's dish count with the brief's.
Render with show_prices false and search the page for a currency sign.
Render a menu of 126 items at 390px.

features.name: Menu highlights
features.description: Up to six dish cards near the top. Pinned dishes first; otherwise dishes that have a picture.
acceptance_criteria: A card has a picture strip only when pictures are allowed and the picture's alt text equals the dish name exactly.
Without pins, and without permission to use pictures, there are no highlights and the section is not drawn.
The section needs at least three cards.
A card shows the dish name, its price (if prices are on) and its description (if the owner's site has one).
verification: Run the highlight tests in test/local-business.test.ts.
Render with and without pictures allowed.

features.name: About us
features.description: The owner's own words, one or two columns.
acceptance_criteria: The text is the owner's text word for word. The heading is the owner's heading, or About us.
With no allowed picture the text uses one column. No box and no slogan is invented.
With no about text the section is not drawn.
verification: Render with and without about text and a picture.

features.name: Gallery and picture permission
features.description: Pictures from the owner's site appear only after the owner confirms they own the site and its pictures.
acceptance_criteria: With usePhotos false the gallery shows labelled colour tiles made from each picture's alt text; with no labels it is not drawn.
With usePhotos true it shows the pictures, with the alt text as a caption on hover and on keyboard focus.
The grid is three columns on desktop with every fifth tile double wide, trimmed so the last row is full; two columns on tablets and one on phones.
The section needs at least three tiles.
verification: Run the gallery tests (every count from 0 to 12 leaves no gap).
Render with usePhotos true and false.

features.name: Reviews
features.description: The owner's testimonials, word for word.
acceptance_criteria: Quotes appear exactly as the owner's site has them. The builder never writes a quote.
Stars appear only for a rating the owner's site showed with the quote.
With no testimonials the section is not drawn and not in the navigation.
verification: Render with no testimonials, one without a rating, one with a rating of 5.

features.name: Catering band
features.description: The owner's catering words and up to four cards, with one button.
acceptance_criteria: Heading, text and cards come from the owner's catering page. Nothing is written for the owner.
The button opens the catering page when there is one, else starts a call, else is not drawn.
With no catering content the section is not drawn.
verification: Render with and without catering content and links.

features.name: Ways to enjoy us
features.description: Up to four action cards: reserve, catering, order online, see the menu.
acceptance_criteria: A card exists only when its link or phone exists. The section needs at least two cards.
Order online opens the restaurant's own ordering page, never a delivery company's home page.
verification: Run the ways-to-order tests.

features.name: Footer
features.description: Contact, Hours and Follow columns and a copyright line.
acceptance_criteria: Address, phone (as a call link) and email (as a mail link) show only when they exist.
Hours show one line per entry exactly as written.
Social links show only with a real https address. A column with nothing in it is not drawn.
The copyright line uses the restaurant's name and the current year.
verification: Render with missing columns.
